reason: Primary purpose is document/media upload bridging: it handles selected file types and turns them into workspace paths so models can access them via downstream tools. Capabilities are local file handling and typed file-path handoff; no evident high-risk behavior.

capabilities: Accepts uploaded images and common document file types
Stores uploads under a workspace directory
Converts uploads into workspace path-based references for downstream model tools
Supports routing hints for both image and document types
